name: Judge Gordon
bio: Gordon, called "Judge," presided over a burlesque court at Medora in July 1885, hearing a mock assault case against Robert Roberts brought by a train-riding drifter. Visitors from Warren, Pennsylvania, sent him a box of cigars that October, and that month the paper named him as a likely justice of the peace if the county organized.

moments.label: Presided over the mock trial of Territory vs. R. Roberts
